issues.text: EventManager.create destructures `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` and then reads `.integration` without optional chaining, so a booking whose location is Google Meet but which has no destinationCalendar throws a TypeError (500) instead of falling back to Cal Video.
issues.zh: EventManager.create 少了 optional chaining，Google Meet 且沒有 destinationCalendar 時整個 booking 會丟 TypeError。改動後拆成 `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? []` 再直接讀 `.integration`，陣列為空時 mainHostDestinationCalendar 是 undefined，讀取屬性直接丟 TypeError。

issues.text: In GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent the fallback `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` is dead code — the else branch is only evaluated when externalCalendarId is falsy, so the comparison is always `cal.externalId === undefined`, which can never match a required String; the result is always undefined and `calendarId: undefined` is passed to calendar.events.update.
issues.zh: Google updateEvent 的 fallback 條件恆不成立：三元的 else 分支只在 externalCalendarId 為 falsy 時才會被求值，而此時 find 的判斷式就是 `cal.externalId === undefined`，永遠不可能成立，所以整個 else 分支是死碼，updateEvent 直接把 `calendarId: undefined` 丟給 calendar.events.update，Google API 呼叫失敗。

issues.text: The same always-false fallback in GoogleCalendarService.deleteEvent makes calendarId undefined, and the downstream `calendarId ? calendarId : defaultCalendarId` silently falls back to "primary", so events created in a specific calendar are deleted from primary instead, leaving undeletable orphan events while cal.com reports success.
issues.zh: deleteEvent 因為下面還有 `calendarId ? calendarId : defaultCalendarId`，會靜默退回 "primary"，於是事件其實建立在指定行事曆上、刪除卻打到 primary，行事曆上留下永遠刪不掉的孤兒事件，而 cal.com 這端看起來是成功的。

issues.text: In organizations/create.handler.ts the IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED condition was inverted when `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` was rewritten as `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`, so with billing enabled the slug is claimed before payment and with billing disabled the organization is created with neither slug nor requestedSlug.
issues.zh: organizations/create.handler.ts 的 IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED 判斷被反轉：原本是 `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })`，改寫成三元時把 `!` 弄丟了，變成 `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})`，結果整個反過來。

issues.text: In createAllCalendarEvents the branch for destinations without a credentialId calls `createEvent(c, event)` and omits the third `externalId` argument (the sibling branch passes `destination.externalId`), so EventResult.externalId is empty and the booking reference is written without externalCalendarId.
issues.zh: createAllCalendarEvents 的兩個分支對 externalId 的處理不一致：有 credentialId 時是 `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`，沒有 credentialId 時卻是 `createEvent(c, event)`，第三個參數漏了，所以只要 destinationCalendar.credentialId 為 null，這筆 booking 的 reference 就會少掉 externalCalendarId。

issues.text: GoogleCalendarService.createEvent now picks the calendar with `find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`, but DestinationCalendar.credentialId is nullable in the schema, so existing rows with a null credentialId match nothing and `selectedCalendar || "primary"` creates the event in the primary calendar instead of the user's configured externalId.
issues.zh: GoogleCalendarService.createEvent 現在用 `find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)` 選行事曆，credentialId 為 null 時比對不到，`selectedCalendar || "primary"` 讓事件建到 primary，而不是使用者設定的 destinationCalendar.externalId。

issues.text: In handleNewBooking, evt.destinationCalendar is set to null when neither the event type nor the organizer has one, and the following `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` is then a silent no-op, so the team members' destination calendars are dropped without any error or log — exactly the COLLECTIVE case this change is meant to fix.
issues.zh: evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...) 在 null 時靜默不執行，團隊成員的行事曆會被丟掉：optional chaining 在 null 時整句是 no-op，沒有例外、沒有 log，teamDestinationCalendars 就消失了。

issues.text: The Calendar interface adds a required credentialId parameter to createEvent, but only GoogleCalendarService reads it; the other 13 implementations (Office365, Lark, CalDAV/BaseCalendarService, …) still use destinationCalendar[0], so multi-target fan-out targets the wrong calendar with the wrong credential and produces extra failing external API calls.
issues.zh: Calendar.createEvent 新增的 credentialId 只有 Google 實作，其餘 13 個 CalendarService 仍固定取 destinationCalendar[0]；一個雙 Office365 host 的 COLLECTIVE 活動，新功能不僅沒生效，還會多產生一次失敗的外部呼叫。

issues.text: In updateAllCalendarEvents the credential is only assigned when both `credentialFromDB && credentialFromDB.app?.slug` hold, yet `updateEvent(credential, ...)` is called unconditionally, so a missing credential passes undefined into updateEvent and throws a TypeError that escapes the function's own catch — unlike createAllCalendarEvents, which guards the identical case with `if (credential)`.
issues.zh: updateAllCalendarEvents 在 DB 也撈不到 credential 時仍把 undefined 丟進 updateEvent，與姊妹區塊的防呆不一致；對照組就在同一個檔案：createAllCalendarEvents 對完全相同的情境有 `if (credential) { ... }` 保護。

issues.text: In handleCancelBooking the recurring-cancellation block, which already iterates over all of the user's calendar credentials and all updatedBookings, is now nested inside the new per-reference `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` loop, so with N calendar references the same set of delete calls is executed N times.
issues.zh: handleCancelBooking 把週期性取消的整段刪除邏輯搬進了 per-reference 迴圈，刪除呼叫會乘上 reference 數量：一筆 booking 有 N 個 calendar reference，就會把同一組刪除呼叫重複執行 N 次。

issues.text: Changing CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar from `DestinationCalendar | null` to `DestinationCalendar[] | null` is a breaking change to the outgoing webhook payload, shipped with no version field, no compatibility window and no changelog entry.
issues.zh: 對外 webhook payload 的 destinationCalendar 形狀變更沒有版本或公告：任何寫了 `payload.destinationCalendar.externalId` 的第三方整合都會在部署當下同時失效，而 MR 內沒有版本欄位、沒有相容期、也沒有 changelog。

issues.text: After the change the webhook payload has three coexisting shapes for the same field — BOOKING_REJECTED now sends [], BOOKING_CREATED and BOOKING_REQUESTED still send null, and configured bookings send an array — with nothing documenting it for consumers.
issues.zh: 改完之後三種形狀並存：BOOKING_REJECTED 送 `[]`，BOOKING_CREATED 與 BOOKING_REQUESTED 仍送 `null`，而有設定時送陣列。消費端要同時處理 null、[] 與陣列三種情況，卻沒有任何文件說明。

issues.text: loadUsers in handleNewBooking is rewritten wholesale even though it has nothing to do with the destinationCalendar change, making it one of the largest structural changes in the PR and adding review cost for no related benefit.
issues.zh: 這段改寫與 destinationCalendar 陣列化沒有關係，卻是整個 MR 中結構變動最大的區塊之一，增加了審查成本。

issues.text: The rewritten dynamic-booking prisma select drops `organization: { select: { slug: true } }`, but IsFixedAwareUser still declares `organization: { slug: string }` and only compiles because of an `as IsFixedAwareUser[]` cast, so the type lies and any future `user.organization.slug` read will be undefined.
issues.zh: 動態預約分支的 prisma select 少了原本的 `organization: { select: { slug: true } }`，但 IsFixedAwareUser 的型別宣告仍然要求 `organization: { slug: string }`；之所以編譯不炸，是因為第 870 行用 `users as IsFixedAwareUser[]` 硬轉——型別在說謊。

issues.text: The new try/catch around loadUsers replaces the original error text with a generic 500 "Unable to load users" and rewrites every HttpError to 400, so specific messages and status codes (e.g. 404) are lost in both the response and the logs.
issues.zh: 新的 try/catch 把 `new Error("dynamicUserList is not properly defined or empty.")` 轉成 statusCode 500、message "Unable to load users"，原始訊息在回應與例外裡都消失；同一個 catch 也會把 HttpError 一律改寫成 400，例如原本的 404 語意會被降級。

issues.text: The "look in the in-memory credentials, otherwise fetch from the DB and hand-map the fields" block is duplicated almost verbatim three times (EventManager.ts twice, handleCancelBooking.ts once), past the rule-of-three threshold for extracting a shared helper, and the hand-mapping risks silently dropping fields such as app.slug.
issues.zh: 「找不到 credential 就進 DB 撈」的區塊重複三次，前兩處連欄位順序都一樣，只有變數名不同。依 Rule of Three，第三次出現就該抽出來。手工映射還有靜默漏欄位的風險。

issues.text: All three credential lookups sit inside per-destination / per-reference loops and issue one `prisma.credential.findUnique` per iteration, an N+1 query pattern on the latency-sensitive synchronous booking create and cancel paths; a single findMany with `id IN (...)` would do.
issues.zh: 三處都位於 per-destination / per-reference 迴圈內，每一筆缺席的 credential 就是一次獨立 round trip——這是典型的 N+1，而且發生在預約建立／取消這種對延遲敏感的同步路徑上。

issues.text: A behavioural refactor spanning 22 files and the booking create/update/cancel paths ships with no new tests — the only test change is one webhook e2e snapshot expectation flipped from null to [] — leaving multi-calendar fan-out, the empty-destinationCalendar Google Meet fallback and legacy credentialId-null rows uncovered.
issues.zh: 跨 22 個檔案的行為重構，測試面只有一個期望值從 null 改成 []——那是被動跟隨實作，不是驗證新行為。多目標行事曆 fan-out、空 destinationCalendar 的 Google Meet 退回路徑、legacy 無 credentialId 的 destinationCalendar，都沒有任何測試覆蓋。

issues.text: Variables that became arrays keep singular names — `bookingCalendarReference` is now the result of `.filter()` and is tested with `.length > 0`, and `calendarReference` is typed `PartialReference[]` — which reads as if a single object were being inspected.
issues.zh: `bookingCalendarReference` 改成 `.filter()` 之後是陣列，名稱仍是單數，下面又寫 `if (bookingCalendarReference.length > 0)`，讀起來像在檢查一個物件的長度。`calendarReference: PartialReference[]` 同樣是單數名。

issues.text: The name `mainHostDestinationCalendar` promises the host's calendar but is only `destinationCalendar[0]`, which in a COLLECTIVE event is the event type's calendar rather than any host's, misleading maintainers into thinking "which host is the main one" has already been handled.
issues.zh: `mainHostDestinationCalendar` 這個名字承諾的是「主辦者的行事曆」，實際上只是 `destinationCalendar[0]`——在 COLLECTIVE 活動裡第 0 個是 eventType 的行事曆而不是任何 host 的，名字與內容不符。

issues.text: The comment `// Find in calEventRaw.destinationCalendar the one with the same credentialId` in GoogleCalendarService is separated from the code it describes by a blank line and merely restates the next line instead of explaining why credentialId is matched and why the fallback is primary.
issues.zh: CalendarService.ts:145 的 `// Find in calEventRaw.destinationCalendar the one with the same credentialId` 後面跟著一行空行才是程式碼，而且這句只是重述下一行在做什麼；真正值得寫的是「為什麼」。

issues.text: handleNewBooking replaces the SchedulingType enum comparison with the literal array `["COLLECTIVE", "ROUND_ROBIN"].includes(...)` while the same file still uses `SchedulingType.ROUND_ROBIN` elsewhere, mixing two styles and losing compile-time protection if the enum is renamed.
issues.zh: handleNewBooking.ts:688 把 SchedulingType 比較改成字面字串陣列 `["COLLECTIVE", "ROUND_ROBIN"].includes(...)`，但同一個檔案第 805 行仍在用 `SchedulingType.ROUND_ROBIN`；同檔兩種寫法並存，且字面字串失去了 enum 改名時的編譯期保護。

issues.text: In packages/lib/CalendarService.ts the destructuring `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event?.destinationCalendar ?? []` is placed inside a reduce callback, recomputing the same value on every iteration instead of being hoisted out.
issues.zh: packages/lib/CalendarService.ts:509 把 `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event?.destinationCalendar ?? []` 放在 reduce 的 callback 內，每一圈都重算一次同樣的值。

open_questions.text: The three new `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id } })` lookups fetch a credential (including its OAuth key) by id with no userId/teamId scoping, unlike the previous code which searched only within the caller's own credential set — is this widening to cross-user credential access deliberately required by the multi-calendar feature, and if so where should the boundary be drawn?
open_questions.zh: 新增的三處 `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id } })` 直接以 id 取出 credential（內含 OAuth key），沒有任何 userId / teamId 範圍限制。這個「跨使用者取用憑證」的放寬是本次多行事曆功能刻意需要的，還是順手寫成的？如果是刻意的，界線應該畫在哪裡？

open_questions.text: When eventType.destinationCalendar and a team member's destinationCalendar point at the same calendar, does the un-deduplicated array produce two duplicate events on that calendar (teamDestinationCalendars is pushed without de-duplication and createAllCalendarEvents does not compare entries)?
open_questions.zh: 當 eventType.destinationCalendar 與某位團隊成員的 destinationCalendar 指向同一個行事曆時，會不會在同一個行事曆上建出兩筆重複事件？

open_questions.text: How many rows in the production DestinationCalendar table have credentialId NULL? That determines whether F-004 immediately affects existing users and whether a backfill migration is needed before merging.
open_questions.zh: 正式環境的 DestinationCalendar 資料表裡，credentialId 為 null 的列有多少？這決定了 F-004 的實際影響範圍。
